title: Stream transcript (invalid): duplicate SESSION_INIT for the same Stream ID
description: Serialized SAR stream transcript with two SESSION_INIT entries for the same Stream ID without an intervening SESSION_CLOSE. The session layer must reject a second SESSION_INIT that would reuse an already-active Stream ID. Must be rejected with SAR_ERR_STREAM_STATE.
notes: This is a serialized SAR stream transcript, not an ordinary static archive.
A SESSION_CLOSE must precede any SESSION_INIT reuse of the same Stream ID.
Additional QUIC control streams are not covered here (future transport-vector work).
